votes.reason: The patch does not reject empty passwords with EMPTY_PASSWORD, changes lockout behavior by resetting failures to 1, and makes an unrelated session token change in src/session.js outside the allowed path.

The patch throws a generic Error("no password") instead of AuthError with code EMPTY_PASSWORD (test FAIL confirms), resets the failure counter to 1 instead of incrementing it, breaking lockout after 5 attempts, and makes an unrelated change to session token entropy in src/session.js, which is outside the allowed src/auth/ path and violates the 'do not change session behaviour' constraint.
